import os,json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    shapes={}
    for v in (2,4,3,7):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w//2,w) if g[r][c]==v]
        if not cells: continue
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        shapes[v]=[[1 if g[r][c]==v else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    frames=[];cur=[]
    for r in range(h):
        if all(x==g[0][0] for x in g[r][:w//2]):
            if cur: frames.append(cur);cur=[]
        else: cur.append(r)
    if cur: frames.append(cur)
    out=[g[r][:w//2] for r in range(h)]
    for rows in frames:
        r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows)
        m=[[1 if g[r][c]==0 else 0 for c in range(1,w//2-1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        color=[v for v,mm in shapes.items() if mm==m][0]
        for i,row in enumerate(m):
            for j,b in enumerate(row):
                if b: out[r0+i][1+j]=color
    return out
